title: Lightly Smoked Algerian Fish Tagine
description: A peppery, light, and quick-fix Algerian dish made with freshly chopped parsley, shio-cure on a raclette-grill. Whole30-friendly
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium-high heat.
Season the halibut fillet with salt and black pepper on both sides.
Brush the onion and garlic on the raclette-grill with a little olive oil.
Place the onion and garlic on the raclette-grill and cook until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley to the raclette-grill and cook for another minute, until slightly wilted.
Place the halibut fillet on the raclette-grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Sprinkle the cumin, coriander, chili pepper, smoked paprika, and crushed red pepper on the halibut fillet.
Squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the halibut fillet, if using.
Serve the halibut hot, garnished with additional parsley and lemon wedges, if desired.
